Name: Travel Center
Author: SpaghettiLord1010
Description:
This mod replaces the unused and somewhat corrupted Summit map which hasn't any use with a Travel Center so you can do the things you want faster and better..
You can even go swimming!

Have fun!


Edit: As far as known the mod is compatible with multiplayer and the SkullCavern Elevator Mod and the Immersive Farm mod 2. 

If you like it, you can [url=https://spaghettilord1010.itch.io/]visit my itch.io page[/url] where I have some games, I wish you fun! (I've also uploaded the mods there!)

Downloads.Description: Simply unzip the file into your Stardew Valley\Mods Folder and you are Ready to run!
